name: Niue
summary_text: Niue: free association with NZ; very small; no documented enforcement but no protections either. Scored as a dependent jurisdiction: the parent framework governs what a visitor encounters, plus local society and enforcement. Score re-anchored 2026-09-24: New Zealand (0.75) plus a local delta of -0.20. This jurisdiction was not covered by the dedicated state/province research passes.

sources.title: Reports of hate crimes against trans people jump 42%, spike month of Posie Parker visit | RNZ
sources.claim_summary: NOTE: This RNZ article is about New Zealand police hate-crime data, not Niue; included as New Zealand context (Niue is a self-governing state in free association with New Zealand).

sources.title: One in five trans and non-binary people threatened with physical violence | RNZ
sources.claim_summary: NOTE: This RNZ article is about the Counting Ourselves survey of trans and non-binary New Zealanders, not Niue; included as New Zealand context.

sources.title: A History of LGBT Criminalisation | Human Dignity Trust
sources.claim_summary: Human Dignity Trust: 'A History of LGBT Criminalisation' - overview of criminalising jurisdictions and strategic litigation (Niue context: no criminalisation as a New Zealand-associated territory).

UN Free & Equal Pacific information sheet (Aug 2015): FAQ on sexual orientation, gender identity and intersex status in the Pacific - documents the fakafifine of Niue among the diverse pre-colonial Pacific gender identities that are 'important parts of the cultural treasure of the region'.

sources.title: Homosexuality in the Ancient Near East, beyond Egypt by Bruce Gerig in the Ancient Near East, beyond Egypt
sources.claim_summary: Bruce L. Gerig, 'Homosexuality in the Ancient Near East, beyond Egypt' - scholarly supplement on homosexuality in ancient Mesopotamian and Near Eastern law codes (Urukagina, Ur-Nammu, Eshnunna, Hammurabi), which 'virtually ignore homosexual acts' - historical context, not Niue-specific.

sources.title: GayLawNet®™ | Laws | Niue | NU
sources.claim_summary: GayLawNet laws page for Niue: age of majority 21 (men)/19 (women) per the Niue Act 1966; age of consent reportedly equalised in 2011; no recognition of same-sex relationships; HIV testing policy for visitors staying longer than two months.
